svg.title: Champion.GG database snowflake schema
svg.desc: Six schema diagrams covering match facts, static dimensions, player history, timelines, Bronze provenance including the temporary _payloads view, and public Gold snapshots and private legacy tables. Keys are listed on every card; lines show logical joins or dependencies, not necessarily enforced foreign keys.
svg.text: 79 tables · 1 temporary view · SQLite + DuckDB · generated from repository definitions
M = source + match_id · P = M + participant_id · T = M + team_id · F = M + frame_index · E = F + event_index
U = source + puuid · O = U + observation_id · V = static_version · G = source + patch + champion_id + role
Solid lines: logical joins. Dashed lines: lineage / dependencies. Lines do not imply enforced foreign keys.

g.text: Participant facts at the center · normalized dimensions branch into versioned definitions

g.text: PUBLIC GOLD - Python writes a dedicated volume; API mount is read-only
PRIVATE LEGACY TABLES - retained for compatibility; not read or refreshed by the API
